title: Hell of a spawn
description: A lightweight Vanilla+ survival modpack where you spawn in the Nether and must fight your way to the Overworld.
body:
🔥 HELL OF A SPAWN 🔥
A lightweight Vanilla+ survival modpack where your journey begins in the Nether.

Survive the burning hell, gather what you can, and fight your way to freedom.
Only then will you reach the Overworld and begin true survival progression.

With BetterNether and BetterEnd, every dimension feels more alive, more dangerous, and more rewarding.

Escape Hell… rebuild the world… and defeat the Dragon.

IMPORTANT!!!
The mod uses datapack witch must be added to your world before generating!!!
It should be in your datapack folder of the your game onec started.
